policy.target: latest stable official tools across supported major versions; one explicitly checked compatible PDF fallback while official ONNX Runtime lacks CPython 3.15 Win AMD64 wheels
policy.scope: every installed component under tool/ and its lockfile-managed runtime dependencies
policy.omitted: Uninstalled git/ and uv-tools/ placeholders are not new installs
policy.sideEffects: never install globally, alter host PATH or registry, or use Windows installers to modify host
policy.compatibility: require Windows 11 x64 native tests, launcher/relocation, package-local paths, Python wheels, npm shim, SSH and browser parity
policy.validation: official source and SHA256 for each artifact; PE architecture, full Python/Node, 19 PowerShell, ten release audits, actual customer ZIP and SHA256; reader/writer identical staged digest; source-only CPython 3.15 wheel exceptions require upstream source hash, audited pure-Python files, deterministic local wheel and explicit import smoke
policy.publish: do not edit installed-tools.json in main until all Windows native tests pass and verified bytes are merged; temporary isolated checkout ledger changes are candidate-only; never create Release
policy.actions: manual user-triggered only; one prepared full refresh batch; no automatic runs

targets.name: python
targets.note: Replace CPython runtime as a cohesive whole, including python315.dll, python315.zip, _pth, stdlib, *.pyd, DLLs and license. Do not mix 3.14 and 3.15.

targets.name: pip
targets.note: Official pip 26.3 stable release (2026-11-02), resolve the one py3-none-any wheel from official PyPI version JSON; verify exact SHA256 before extracting, do not trust an unpinned redirect.

targets.name: paramiko
targets.note: Audit six pinned SSH runtime dependencies for available stable win_amd64 wheels; rebuild if necessary.

targets.name: node
targets.note: Official nodejs/node GitHub latest release on audit date; do not overwrite just to refresh timestamp.

targets.name: npm
targets.note: npm v12.2.1 engines supports Node >=26.0.0; retain custom portable npm/npx entry points.

targets.name: playwright-mcp
targets.note: Upstream v0.0.84 locks playwright and playwright-core 1.65.0-alpha-2026-10-30; latest stable MCP release does not imply stable transitive libraries. Do not replace or label fully stable until dependency policy is reviewed.

targets.name: chromium
targets.note: Keep exactly one browser; choose upstream-pinned Chrome for Testing win64 build and regenerate per-file hash manifest; do not independently update to generic Chrome latest.

targets.name: 7zip
targets.note: Treat official Windows x64 self-extracting installer ONLY as a data archive, extract with old bundled 7z.exe, never execute downloaded installer. Verify both full 7z.exe and 7z.dll are AMD64 PE.

targets.name: pyinstaller
targets.note: PyInstaller is part of the installed Python package closure even though not listed in installed-tools.json.

trackedDependencyScopes.description: All pinned base Python packages including native cp315 wheels and build dependencies
All locked Playwright MCP npm dependencies and browser revision
Optional but already bundled Python features and licenses

blockingGates: Do not run 03 prepare with this plan alone: the current updater does not support the full Python/Node/npm/Corepack/Playwright/browser refresh.
Require a complete all-tools-capable, bounded writer/verifier implementation and offline regression before requesting the sole manual Windows Actions run.
Require exact official SHA256 and downloaded bytes for every new wheel/tarball/binary and pinned lockfile reconciliation.
Do not change an installed version record until the verified exact bytes are merged into main.

pythonPureSourceExceptions.name: PyYAML
pythonPureSourceExceptions.reason: PyYAML official 6.0.3 has no cp315-win_amd64 wheel. Do not install unapproved pyyaml-cp315 fork or downgrade Python.
pythonPureSourceExceptions.strategy: From the exact official source tar.gz, repackage the 17 pure-Python lib/yaml/*.py modules and upstream license/PKG-INFO as a verified local py3-none-any wheel. Never run setup.py, compile the optional C extension, or fetch a third-party wheel. Lock generated wheel digest and test yaml.safe_load/safe_dump.

pythonPdfCompatibilityException.reason: PyMuPDF 2.1 enables ONNX Layout by default, but official stable ONNX Runtime has no CPython 3.15 Windows x64 wheel on 2026-11-03
pythonPdfCompatibilityException.when: Only if current official onnxruntime stable PyPI release lacks verified cp315 or compatible abi3 win_amd64 wheel
pythonPdfCompatibilityException.layout: not installed; 4LLM 0.3.4 uses the same legacy PDF->Markdown mode already bundled in this project
pythonPdfCompatibilityException.constraints: PyPI official stable release JSON and wheel URL/SHA256 must match pip downloaded bytes, wheel ABI must support CPython 3.15, 4LLM Layout remains optional, and Windows native PDF-to-Markdown must pass; never bypass requirements or install 3.14 extensions
pythonPdfCompatibilityException.automaticUpgrade: When official ONNX Runtime latest stable publishes a matching cp315/abi3 Win AMD64 wheel, use PyMuPDF >=2.1 Core/Layout/4LLM matching release instead
